programmes.d: Gibbs and the team are called to investigate when a group of teens on a nature hike discover Marine dog tags in a national forest.
Gibbs and the team are called in when a teenage student at a Quantico base high school attaches a bomb to his body and holds his fellow students hostage.

Gibbs and the team are called in when a couple of kids stumble upon the body of a missing Marine in a frozen lake. As the team searches the frozen lakebed for clues, they come across three more bullet-ridden bodies.

Gibbs and the team are called in when a Pentagon cryptographer suspected of spying apparently commits suicide. With their prime suspect dead, the NCIS team must uncover whether or not she was the Pentagon's mole.
Elka goes after a silver fox, Melanie gets trapped in her closet with Frankie and Victoria ditches Joy as her lifestyle website sidekick.

To get a part on her HBO show, Victoria's father lies to her and says he's dying, and Melanie takes Frankie's advice in how to break up with clingy Jack.
Joy's frumpy sister Jill becomes a knockout, Victoria and Melanie collaborate on a children's book with a tight deadline, and Elka welcomes an earl and his dignitaries.
Joy realizes she's in love with Bob, Victoria tries to keep up with the much younger Barney, and Melanie is visited by her childhood bully.

McGarrett was tried for murder by dangerous convicts led by enemy Honore Vashon after surrendering for hostages' release. Vashon, seeking revenge, intends to execute McGarrett, but McGarrett has doubt of Vashon's true motives.

McGarrett & hardboiled Dr. Ormsbee clash over top-secret research & defected physicist Chiang Lee seeking asylum in the US. McGarrett is unsure of Ormsbee & Chiang but starts to suspect Chiang of sinister motives.

Helen Hayes guest stars as Danny's visiting Aunt Clara. The murder of Clara's plane seatmate leads McGarrett to a small band of crooks stealing from abandoned bank accounts, money belonging to Hawaii.

Stabbed critically, a college football star is brought to a hospital by two other stars of the team, instigating a Five-O investigation involving the son of a well-known U.S. Senator and a cold-blooded cover-up of a gang rape.
After discovering that a grisly murder scene was staged, the team realizes that Abby was the intended target when some key evidence contaminates her lab and almost kills her.
